verdict.rationale: cubic explicitly documents a 'memory-and-learning' mechanism where it learns from reply/reaction feedback to calibrate future reviews, backed by a persistent `cubic.yaml` config that stores custom agents/rules encoding team conventions, plus an AI wiki that indexes codebase context — together forming a persistent, applied memory of conventions and past decisions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating that learned preferences reliably persist and improve accuracy over time, and detail on scope/limits of what is remembered across large teams or repos.
